rows.title_short: Financial Rehabilitation And Insolvency Act ( F R I A) Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"Financial Rehabilitation And Insolvency Act (FRIA) Of 2009.\" Seeks to restore the Debtor to a condition of successful operation and solvency, if it is shown that its continuance of operation is economically feasible; provide a clear framework for the insolvency proceedings for companies who are undergoing financial restructuring or rehabilitation or those unable to pay its liabilities or has liabilities greater than its assets, and; provide equitable treatment to all parties involved in a financial restructuring or rehabilitation.
rows.status: REPUBLIC ACT RA10142 (Lapsed into law on 2010-07-18)

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING REFORMS IN THE REAL PROPERTY VALUATION AND ASSESSMENT PRACTICES IN THE PHILIPPINES AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: Real Property Valuation Reform Act Of 2009
rows.abstract: \"Real Property Valuation Reform Act Of 2009.\" Seeks to remove confusion and provide reliable basis for the assessment of real property taxes, reduce costs of duplication through a single valuation base, and a single appraisal agency, and; establish an efficient and equitable utilization and allocation of land market in the Philippines that shall contribute to the country's economic growth, provide opportunities to the poor and encourage the optimal management and use of land resources.
rows.status: Measure reconsidered on 2010-01-19

second_reading.reasons: to give time for the Members to interpellate the sponsor.
second_reading.remarks: On Jan. 19, 2010, the Body approved to consider the Explanatory Note of the Bill as the sponsorship remarks on the measure; terminated the period of sponsorship and debate; terminated the period of amendments and approved the same on Second Reading. On  the same date, on motion of Rep. Cerilles, citing that he intends to interpellate the sponsor of the bill, the same was reconsidered. However, upon his discussion with the sponsor  of the bill, the motion for reconsideration was withdrawn and subsequently, the bill was approved on Second Reading. At the later time, on motion of Rep. Velarde, the same was again reconsidered to give chance for other Members to interpellate the sponsor.
